name: 金庸群侠传2013_服务器版
group_note: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传2013_服务器版), sibling of jyqxc/jyqxc2 (same architecture family; not file-identical). Two bugs fixed, both in adm/daemons/combatd.lpc: (1) `#include </quest/quest.h>` used angle-bracket absolute-path syntax, which this driver resolves relative to the configured include directory (/include), not mudlib root -- every other absolute-path include in this codebase correctly uses quoted syntax (#include "/path.h"), so this one file's unique angle-bracket form failed with 'Cannot #include /quest/quest.h', which cascaded into 'Undefined function quest_finished' and left combatd.lpc uncompiled ('No program in object'), breaking score display for every player. Fixed by quoting the include. (2) Once the include resolved, quest.h's top-level `mapping quest_name = ([...]);` landed before combatd.lpc's `inherit F_DBASE;` (the #include was above the inherit line), which this driver disallows ('Illegal to inherit after defining global variables') -- fixed by moving the #include below the inherit statement. Also carried over jyqxc/jyqxc2's already-known short()/capitalize(query("id")) guard fix in feature/name.lpc (same legacy-binary-save-format board crash). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist (note: original file had no trailing newline before the new entry -- added one to keep the two entries on separate lines). Full registration->look->score->quit and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter reverted 3 corrupted ASCII-art map files (same pattern as jyqxc/jyqxc2).
